description: Manages the hierarchical structure of partners, including categories and groups, for organizational and classification purposes.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new partner tree node for organizing partner hierarchies and classifications.

req.description: Partner tree data model with hierarchy information

example_uses: Create a new partner category for Government
Add a partner group under UN Agencies
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to create, add, or set up new partner categories, groups, or hierarchy structures.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves all partner tree nodes (categories and groups) with sorting and access control.
example_uses: Show all partner categories and groups
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to see partner categories, groups, hierarchy, or classification structure.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific partner tree node by ID with complete hierarchy details and permissions.
example_uses: Show me details for partner category ID 123
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific partner tree node details by ID or when you need complete hierarchy information.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates multiple partner tree nodes (categories and groups) with new hierarchy information and properties.

req.description: Array of partner tree data models to update

example_uses: Update partner category names and descriptions
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or reorganize partner tree structure or classifications.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Soft deletes a partner tree node from the hierarchy (marks as deleted rather than permanent removal).

id.description: Partner tree node ID to delete

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or eliminate a partner category, group, or tree node.

endpoints.name: PermissionsGet
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current user's permissions for a specific partner tree node (read, update, delete).

id.description: Partner tree node ID to check permissions for

example_uses: Check my permissions for partner category 123
What can I do with partner group 456?
Get access rights for this tree node
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to check user permissions before performing operations or showing UI elements for partner tree management.

endpoints.name: GetCategoryAndGroupStructure
endpoints.description: Retrieves the complete partner category and group structure as a hierarchical tree for organizational navigation.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user needs to see the complete partner organizational structure, hierarchy, or when building navigation trees.

endpoints.name: GetPartnersByPartnerGroup
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of partners filtered by specific partner group code with access control and sorting.

code.description: Partner group code to filter by (e.g., 'GOV', 'NGO', 'UNAGENCY')

request.description: Pagination request containing page size and index

example_uses: List all NGO partners with pagination
Get UN agency partners sorted by name
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to filter or search partners by partner group, organization type, or institutional classification.

endpoints.name: GetPartnersByPartnerCategory
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of partners filtered by specific partner category code with access control and sorting.

code.description: Partner category code to filter by (e.g., 'NATIONAL', 'INTERNATIONAL', 'BILATERAL')

request.description: Pagination request containing page size and index

example_uses: Show all national partners in this category
Get bilateral partners sorted by name
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to filter or search partners by partner category, operational scope, or geographic classification.

endpoints.name: GetAllPartnerCategories
endpoints.description: Retrieves all partner categories with their partner counts for statistical analysis and diagram generation.
example_uses: Get all partner categories with counts
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see partner distribution across categories, generate statistics, or create visual diagrams of partner categorization.

endpoints.name: GetAllPartnerGroups
endpoints.description: Retrieves all partner groups with their partner counts for statistical analysis and diagram generation.
example_uses: Get all partner groups with counts
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see partner distribution across groups, generate statistics, or create visual diagrams of partner grouping.

endpoints.name: GetPartnerCategorizationOverview
endpoints.description: Retrieves complete partner categorization overview with both categories and groups including partner counts for comprehensive analysis and diagram generation.
example_uses: Show partner distribution across categories and groups
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants a complete overview of partner organization, comprehensive statistics, or to create detailed diagrams showing both categories and groups.
